prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint full CONCEPT A for a 40 by 30 square-cell medieval walled district. CRITICAL generate a LARGE actual source drawing at 3072 x 2304 pixels (4:3); minimum source 2560x1920, never a smaller image upscaled. It will be REDUCED to 1920x1440, 48 pixels per cell. Solid pure magenta #ff00ff outside the city. No text, grid lines or labels.
References: image 1 house and image 2 hall define the exact high three-quarter RPG town view, top-left light, warm cream plaster, recessed windows, dark timber, stone plinth, visible large roof slopes, clean discrete tile clusters. Image 3 is an appearance/composition reference to improve, not an edit target.
PLAN in cell coordinates, north at top: perimeter curtain on x0..2 and x38..40, north wall y2..4, south wall y28..30. Ditch outside north wall y0..1. Uneven towers only IN wall line, NW corner bastion. One-cell inner service lane with meaningful bends at towers. Actual north-to-south entry route comes through south gate at x25..27, bends west one cell at y24, then follows x24..26 to the square. Continuous TWO CELL clear walking width, kerbs outside, no pinch. Ordinary streets ONE CELL wide, passages half-cell. Widen/jog/junction within every eight cells, never a long unchanged corridor.
Dense connected perimeter blocks with complete outward-facing house lots on ALL FOUR sides, including side doors, corner returns and back faces; roofed rear wings fill their interiors with only one small purposeful rear court per selected block. No detached houses, no buildings standing in open paving. Northwest terracotta artisan block x3..12/y5..14; central merchants/guildhall x13..25/y5..14; NE slate rich block x26..37/y5..14. West craft/church strip x3..16/y15..21, east inn/trades strip x26..37/y15..21. Southern continuous low terraced frontages x3..24/y23..27 and x27..37/y23..27, with a real complete jogged frontage/wedge and rear-lane T near x28/y24, no clipped half-house.
Irregular civic square core x16..24/y15..22 with one-cell notch: guildhall's three arcades directly on NORTH edge, church EAST porch directly on WEST edge, a continuous WEST-FACING inn porch/front along EAST across the two-cell route, complete market hall directly SOUTH. Hall is one complete low roofed building: continuous roof over supported four-bay arcade, open NORTH entry toward square UNDER the eave, no floating arcade above roof. Six 1-cell stalls in two rows of three inside square, clear aisle and church approach, fountain offset in open middle.
The south gate is one substantial coherent twin-tower gate chamber at x24.5..27.5/y26..30 with a true two-cell passage, inner soffit depth, chamber spanning both towers, wall-walk top landings on both sides and east stair. Buildings are mixed 2-5 storeys, taller merchants centrally, 1-2 storeys periphery; no needle corner towers. Mixed terracotta/slate/brown roofs but one roof colour and max two wall colours per block. Attached rows, strong street walls. No lawns at frontages, back gardens only enclosed. Calm cobbles, stepped hard shadows to southeast. Keep architectural edges angular, square grid orthogonal front elevations with roof depth matching refs, no axonometric diamond city. Pixel art, uniform native scale, one native pixel dark exposed contour, no rounded blocks, blobs, smears, noise, flecks, haze or fog.
